title: harness-descriptor
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

id.description: Id of the harness, unique in the resolved registry
id.x-type-in-words: Lower-case text with digits and hyphens

id.description: Identity used for the diversity test and for the terms lookup

termsRef.description: Row of the terms-gate data, or null for unknown terms

detect.description: How presence is established free of charge: variables whose presence counts; for `cli` the executable, how to read its version, which help text must be present, the configuration home

tiers.description: Auth tiers offered: 1, 2 or both. 3 is never valid

credential.description: Secret reference, or null when the harness owns its login

preflight.description: A free read-only request and the statuses that mean an auth failure; redirects refused

endpoint.description: Base address, path of the chat call, path of the model list

models.description: Default model; whether the list is probed or declared; the context window with its source; the output cap with its source; how a model is selected

roles.description: Per role: whether supported, with the reason if not; for a critic: `toolless` (`structural`, `flag`, `config`, `none`), `readOnlyTools` (supported or not), `freshSession`

invoke.description: Per role, for `cli`: argument list as a list, how the prompt is given and its size limit, working directory, environment, permission mechanism, files to write before the call

usage.description: Where input, output and cache tokens are found

mapping.description: A data mapping from the harness's records to the six normalized records of §C.5: selector of the record kind and field paths

dialect.description: Name of a row of the dialect table of §C.5

continuation.description: Whether supported, how an id is given, and `cacheTtlSec`, the cache lifetime of a session in seconds (300 where none is declared)

session.description: Where session state lives and how it is redirected

tiers.description: The model-tier ladder of the harness, lowest first

failures.description: Map from the typed failure vocabulary of §C.1 to what signals it: statuses, body patterns, exit codes, stream records

cost.description: Class (`subscription`, `metered`, `local`, `unknown`) and prices with their date, or null

envAllow.description: The only variables handed to a call

configHome.description: Variables and seeds of an overlay (§C.16)

ceiling.description: Highest containment level the harness can enforce, with provenance

memory.description: Whether the harness has native memory and how it is switched off

off.description: Variables or flags that switch the harness's own telemetry off

concurrentSessions.description: Whether several processes may run at once under one configuration home and one login, with separate session stores
concurrentSessions.x-type-in-words: Truth value with provenance, or null

spendLimit.description: Whether a process-level spending limit can be set, and how

transports.description: The transports offered, each with auth tier and terms row
transports.x-required: No; default one `subprocess` or `direct-call` by kind

versionRange.description: Tested range and date; present only on a tested harness adapter

verifiedOn.description: Tested range and date; present only on a tested harness adapter
